title: Warbell Runner
text: Warbell Runner sprints ahead of the boarding line and rings a hand bell to mark vulnerable prey. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: One clear note can summon an entire deck crew.

defeatReward.text: Warbell Runner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
